scope: Machine-readable acceptance matrix for cockpit and governance readiness criteria that must stay mapped to route/API ownership, UI state, automated coverage, and evidence artifacts.

criteria.criterion: Trading readiness summarizes DK1 trust, paper-session continuity, replay status, execution controls, brokerage sync, report-pack readiness, and evidence completeness before an operator accepts paper operation.
criteria.uiBehaviorState: The readiness console must show Ready, ReviewRequired, Blocked, and loading/error postures with gate-level disabled reasons, work-item details, and route-aware recovery actions.

automatedTests.filterableName: operator-readiness-console.view-model.test.ts > builds the API-first readiness console from shared workstation payloads
Trading readiness overall posture follows canonical gate precedence

artifacts.description: Readiness console showing current gate states and recovery actions.
Signed DK1 trust packet that feeds readiness posture.

criteria.criterion: Operator inbox aggregates actionable readiness, reconciliation, brokerage, promotion, Security Master, and report-pack blockers without losing target routes or account scope.
criteria.uiBehaviorState: The inbox must prioritize critical rows, preserve selected detail, expose retry when the inbox fails, clear stale account-scoped rows while loading a new account, and keep fallback rows visible for triage.

automatedTests.filterableName: operator-readiness-console.view-model.test.ts > surfaces operator inbox failures while keeping payload fallbacks visible

artifacts.description: Inbox queue with critical ordering and selected work-item detail.
Captured inbox response used during acceptance review.

criteria.criterion: Governed report-pack evidence must be discoverable from Reporting and linked from cockpit work items before acceptance can claim report output readiness.
criteria.uiBehaviorState: Evidence workbench links must preserve subjectKind and subjectId query parameters, and report-pack states must distinguish missing payload, in-review, approved, released, and export-busy states.

automatedTests.filterableName: workspace.test.ts > builds encoded Evidence Workbench subject routes
operator-readiness-console.view-model.test.ts > keeps the headline in review when governed report-pack readiness is missing
governance-screen.view-model.test.ts > derives reporting profile selector rows and detail state

artifacts.description: Report-pack manifest with template, run, approval, and release metadata.
Evidence workbench showing subject-scoped report evidence.

criteria.criterion: Reconciliation breaks must be visible as governance work items with deterministic detail, resolve/dismiss action state, narratives, and evidence packet links.
criteria.uiBehaviorState: The reconciliation lane must render open-break counts, selected detail, resolve/dismiss validation, failure copy, narrative context, and evidence packet actions for the selected run.

automatedTests.filterableName: governance-screen.view-model.test.ts > derives reconciliation break action state and live announcements
governance-screen.view-model.test.ts > derives reconciliation detail actions from the selected run

artifacts.description: Replay output proving break queue state and transitions.
Reconciliation detail with evidence packet actions.

criteria.criterion: Fund account context must thread through readiness and inbox calls so account-scoped brokerage and reconciliation blockers do not leak across accounts.
criteria.uiBehaviorState: Account changes must trigger scoped reloads, abort superseded inbox loads, clear stale rows, and keep the visible account context attached to action metadata.

automatedTests.filterableName: operator-readiness-console.view-model.test.ts > clears stale account-scoped inbox rows while loading a new fund account inbox
operator-readiness-console.view-model.test.ts > aborts superseded operator inbox loads when the fund account changes

artifacts.description: Scoped readiness response for the accepted fund account.
Scoped inbox response proving no cross-account leakage.

criteria.criterion: Replay mismatch, stale replay, and promotion-review blockers must keep mirrored run identity, route metadata, and packet continuity across readiness, inbox, and evidence views.
criteria.uiBehaviorState: Replay and promotion rows must expose mismatch reasons, stale replay recovery, mirrored run IDs, promotion packet action labels, and selected evidence-panel details.

automatedTests.filterableName: operator-readiness-console.view-model.test.ts > maps replay mismatch and stale replay gates into the normalized checkpoints
operator-readiness-console.view-model.test.ts > keeps mirrored run-handoff identity and route metadata in operator work items
operator-readiness-console.view-model.test.ts > preserves route-aware packet continuity for blocker rows across state slices

artifacts.description: Replay acceptance output with mismatch and freshness metadata.
Promotion review packet manifest tied to mirrored run identity.
